source.upstream: references/styles/01_通用母版/设计流派/单色满版海报风.md

visual_language.direction: single brand color flooded poster deck, one saturated hue filling the canvas with black or white reversed giant type, type-as-hero stacked lockups, two-tone color-block splits, zero imagery — the type is the hero

content_review.reviewer_note: 结构完整（负面约束+密度映射在案）：候选晋升，需 U3 语义审阅补主题绑定与特征后转 active

legacy_payload.best_for: 以单一品牌主色满版铺底、黑或白反差巨字的字体即主视觉语言,做品牌策略、campaign 宣讲与文化页;撞色两层,纯色块零素材
legacy_payload.visual_direction: single brand color flooded poster deck, one saturated hue filling the canvas with black or white reversed giant type, type-as-hero stacked lockups, two-tone color-block splits, zero imagery — the type is the hero

canvas.background: 单一品牌主色满版(示例 Spotify 绿 #1ED760;每 deck 换用自己品牌色,Mailchimp 黄/Netflix 红同级)
canvas.composition: 字体即主视觉:顶天立地的超大字组占满画面;双色块上下/左右分割做节奏
canvas.density: low,纯色块+大字,零素材零插画

color_palette.primary: #1ED760(品牌主色满版,示例锚;交付时以品牌 HEX 替换)
color_palette.rule: 撞色只有两层:品牌主色 × 黑或白反差;禁第三色与渐变;字重 900 + 负字距制造海报感

typography.title: 超粗无衬线(Inter / Manrope / Archivo Black 气质,思源黑体 Heavy),font-weight 900 + 负 letter-spacing
typography.body: 同族常规字重,短句;正文尽量少
typography.labels: 大写小标签,反差色描边或色块载体

layout_patterns: 主视觉页 = 品牌色满版 + 反白/反黑巨字组顶天立地(单色块背景)
双色页 = 上下/左右两个色块分割(品牌色 × 黑/白),各承载一句主张
巨型数字页 = 数字撑满画面,反差色
主张页 = 满版色 + 一行 slogan + hashtag
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: 字体当图用:每一页的主角都是字,不是图形素材;纯色块零贴图是本风格最强工程优势
negative_prompt: no third color and no gradients — two-tone brand color versus black/white only
no stock imagery or illustration; the type is the visual
no thin elegant weights; display stays at 900 with negative tracking
no quiet low-contrast pastel versions; the brand hue stays saturated

visual_elements.allowed: 满版色块,反差巨字组,双色块分割,巨型数字,hashtag 口号
visual_elements.avoid: 图片素材;插画;第三色;渐变;细字重

rendering_constraints: Flooded single-hue canvas; black or white reversed type only.
legacy_payload.reference: GitHub: huashu-design · design-styles.md PPT 库「高饱和单色品牌撞色海报」

recommendation_features.feature_defaults_basis: family-prior (U3)：机械默认按家族语义先验替换，来源记录在案

negative: Flooded single-hue canvas; black or white reversed type only.
